name: Guillotine
summary: Card game where players manipulate a queue of French nobles to behead and collect the most valuable heads.
rules_text: Setup two shuffled decks: 50 nobles and 60 action cards. Deal 5 action cards to each player. Game lasts 3 days. Each day, reveal 12 noble cards face-up in a line; the right end is the front (guillotine). On your turn: you may play one action card from hand for its effect such as moving nobles forward/back in line, adding/removing nobles, drawing cards, or gaining points; then collect the front noble of the line and place it face-up in your score pile, resolving any collection ability on it; then draw one action card. Play passes left. When the line is empty at start of a turn, the day ends and a new line of 12 is dealt. First player rotates each day. After 3 days, sum points on collected nobles plus any modifiers from action cards; highest total wins.
rating_reason: Line drafting with action cards from hand, turn-based collection scoring.
